parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
A geometric progression has first term 3a and common ratio r. A second geometric progression
has first term a and common ratio −2r. The two progressions have the same sum to infinity.
Find the value of r.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The first two terms of an arithmetic progression are 15 and 19 respectively. The first two terms
of a second arithmetic progression are 420 and 415 respectively. The two progressions have the
same sum of the first n terms. Find the value of n.

text: Machines in a factory make cardboard cones of base radius r cm and vertical height h cm. The volume,
V cm , of such a cone is given by V = 0r h. The machines produce cones for which h + r = 18.
The points A 1, 1 and B 5, 9 lie on the curve 6y = 5x − 18x + 19.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Relative to an origin O, the position vectors of two points P and Q are p and q respectively. The
point R is such that PQR is a straight line with Q the mid-point of PR. Find the position vector
of R in terms of p and q, simplifying your answer.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The vector 6i + aj + bk has magnitude 21 and is perpendicular to 3i + 2j + 2k. Find the possible
values of a and b, showing all necessary working.
